whatsappMessage:
Hi Hardcore Gym Team,

I noticed your gym has strong 4.6★ reviews from 140+ members in Patna, but your GitHub Pages website link is currently showing a 404 error and is offline for new inquiries.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://hardcore-gym.github.io/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Hardcore Gym Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We noticed your current website link was down, so we rebuilt it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your top training programs in Boring Canal Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
